description: This Java class defines a utility factory for creating various types of metrics instruments (Counter, Gauge, Histogram, Timer) used within the Ditto framework. It provides static methods to instantiate different metric objects with optional tagging support.

classes.name: DittoMetrics
classes.description: A utility class containing static factory methods for creating different metrics instruments such as counters, gauges, histograms, and timers.

methods.name: timer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new timer object with the specified name using DefaultTimerBuilder.

methods.name: expiringTimer
methods.description: Returns an ExpiringTimerBuilder for creating customizable timer objects.

methods.name: counter
methods.description: Creates a Counter instrument with the specified name.

methods.name: counter
methods.description: Creates a Counter instrument with the specified name and tags.

methods.name: gauge
methods.description: Creates a Gauge instrument with the specified name.

methods.name: histogram
methods.description: Creates a Histogram instrument with the specified name.
